reason: I paid a creator once, got likes and no customers, so a number per creator is exactly what I'm missing. It's free to try, there's no app, and ₹299 is nothing next to what one bad creator cost me, so I'd try it at one outlet next time a creator comes asking.
objection: My counter staff at rush hour won't remember to type a PIN or note a code, so the count will come out low and I won't know if the creator flopped or my staff just skipped it. And the creator has to send me the link, so the ones who are only after a free meal will never bother.
would_change_my_mind: If I could send the Mitra link to the creator myself as a condition of the deal, and staff just had to scan or tap once, I'd roll it out to all my outlets, not just one.
